current_date: January 2024 ('Version 2 (Adopted January 2024)'; page header also reads 'Version 3 TS 15.01.2024')
current_evidence: The council's 'Validation checklist' web page (article 14012) shows 'Version 2 (Adopted January 2024)' after a consultation from 14 Sept to 14 Oct 2023. Grokbot's extracted text carries the same version labels, and searches found no 2025/2026 revision.

issues.detail: Grokbot's PDF link returned a client error when fetched, so its content could not be confirmed directly; the HTML version of the same checklist on sunderland.gov.uk does load. The council site also still has a 'Validation checklist pdf' page (article 18176) holding the superseded Version 1.1 from October 2016, which users could confuse with the current list. The reference row's 'Planning page' is only the council homepage.

'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' and 'Minerals / Waste specific statements' are filed under Householder, but the trigger Grokbot quotes says householder extensions are excluded. Both rows also reuse the same coal-mining excerpt.
issues.evidence: Item 14: 'normally only required for development in Coal Mining Development High Risk Areas with the exception of householder extensions or alterations, changes of use and shop front alterations'

issues.detail: 'Landscaping scheme' is filed under Change of use - prior approval, but the source excludes changes of use. 'Planning Obligations / S106' is filed under Householder only because its excerpt runs on into the protected-species text ('All applications (including householders)'); the real trigger is where pre-app advice says a S106 is needed.
issues.evidence: Item 19: 'Planning applications (except those for the change of use or alteration to an existing building), where landscaping would be a significant consideration'

issues.detail: Listed building consent and Demolition in a conservation area are both '(none)', yet the Heritage Statement is required for LBC and Conservation Area Consent. A Structural Survey is required for demolition affecting conservation-area buildings and for works affecting a listed building's structure, Archaeological assessment covers demolition or major alteration of historic buildings, and Marketing information covers demolition of listed or locally listed buildings. Reserved matters is '(none)', though the Sustainability Statement explicitly applies to major reserved matters. Advertisement consent is '(none)', while the advert illumination/luminance item is filed under Full planning.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement: 'Listed Building Consent, Conservation Area Consent, major schemes in or affecting conservation areas...'; Item 27: 'Most major full planning applications and major reserved matter applications'

issues.detail: About 40 rows carry 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' although the checklist sets triggers by scale or location and Appendix 2 has separate checklists for Full, Outline/RM, LBC/CAC, Advertisement and Householder. Examples: BNG applies to all non-householder applications; Air Quality applies at 10+ homes/0.5 ha or 1,000 sq m/1 ha whatever the application type; Outline is wrongly left as '(none)'.
issues.evidence: Item 15: BNG 'for all non-householder applications'; Appendix 2 Checklists 1-5

issues.detail: Missing local requirements: Town Centre Use Assessment (item 29: main town centre uses outside existing centres; sequential test, plus impact assessment above 2,500 sq m); Masterplan (item 10: 250+ homes or non-residential sites over 5 ha); Ecological Impact Assessment (non-householder schemes affecting semi-natural habitats, within item 15); the Planning Statement's need statement for waste facilities (item 24). Items 31-40 could not be fully read within the fetch budget, so other omissions are possible.
issues.evidence: Item 29 Town Centre Use Assessment; Item 10: 'Masterplans for 250+ homes or non-residential sites over 5ha'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or description text with no trigger. Air Quality: 'where the proposal will;' (real: 10+ homes or 0.5 ha+, or 1,000 sq m+ or 1 ha+, combined with factors such as 10+ parking spaces or centralised combustion). Flood Risk Assessment: 'assessment and flood risk assessment).' (real: FZ2/3, sites of 1 ha+, critical drainage areas). HRA, EIA and FRA all use the same boilerplate '(such as Environmental Impact Assessment, Habitats Regulations assessment and flood risk assessment)'. Heritage: 'also include a Heritage Statement (see requirement 16).' Archaeology: 'When is this required? Archaeological desk based assessment' (real: near Scheduled Monuments or HER sites, greenfield 1 ha+, historic building demolition). Tree survey, Contaminated land and Noise quote content or standards lists, not triggers. BNG, Parking, Transport Assessment and Fire are cut-off fragments.
issues.evidence: Item 12 Air Quality and Item 16 Flood Risk triggers on the council's Validation checklist page

issues.detail: Several rows are labelled with a requirement the excerpt does not describe. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' has the arboricultural method statement sentence. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage' is a servicing-plan bullet from the transport item. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' carries the Flood Risk Assessment trigger instead of the drainage assessment trigger (all major development). 'Employment / Economic Statement' is the fragment 'on designated employment land.' from the Marketing Information item. 'Block plan / Site plan' quotes a list of national requirements.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt for Schedule of works: 'an Aboricultural Method Statement (AMS) with a Tree Protection Plan.'

issues.detail: Item 33 (Sunlight/Daylight/Microclimate Assessment) appears three times: as 'Daylight / Sunlight / Overshadowing', 'Tall buildings / Wind microclimate' (identical excerpt) and 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' (fragment 'living and amenity spaces.'). 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' share one excerpt. Coal Mining and Minerals/Waste duplicate each other under Householder.
issues.evidence: Both rows quote '33 Sunlight/Daylight/Microclimate Assessment When is this required? a) When a proposed development is in close proximity to the windows...'

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is the document's table of contents ('Consultation Variances Pre-application Advice ... Local Authority Contact Details Appendix 1 ...'), not a requirement. In tab_items, 'GIS files in shapefile format... may be requested' is a process note, and two 'Local Flood Risk Management Strategy b&ftype=...PDF' entries are URL fragments. The 'Marketing' trigger is a caveat about agreeing marketing scope at pre-app, not a trigger.
issues.evidence: Grokbot row text: 'Consultation Variances Pre-application Advice and Discretion Review Using the Checklist ... National Requirements 1. 2. 3. ...'

summary: Grokbot's link points to the current Sunderland checklist (Version 2, adopted January 2024), though the PDF could not be fetched and a stale 2016 version is still on the council site. The extraction has serious app-type errors: Coal Mining is placed under Householder although householders are excluded, Landscaping under change of use although changes of use are excluded, and LBC is '(none)' despite the Heritage Statement. Many triggers are boilerplate fragments or come from other items, and the Town Centre Use Assessment and Masterplan requirements are missing.
